result.message: Testing stage. You will be given 2 test inputs, one at a time and answered separately. Apply the same transformation rule to each and submit the predicted output grid with submit_final_answer.

output.arguments:
{"code":"def transform(grid):
    import copy
    out=copy.deepcopy(grid)
    pts=[(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v==8]
    if not pts: return out
    r0=min(r for r,c in pts); r1=max(r for r,c in pts)
    c0=min(c for r,c in pts); c1=max(c for r,c in pts)
    # external colored marks project along their row/column onto the rectangle boundary
    for r,row in enumerate(grid):
        for c,v in enumerate(row):
            if v==0 or v==8: continue
            if r0<=r<=r1:
                if c<c0: out[r][c0]=v
                elif c>c1: out[r][c1]=v
            if c0<=c<=c1:
                if r<r0: out[r0][c]=v
                elif r>r1: out[r1][c]=v
    return out"}
